$comment: Records in `modules::registry::ALL` whose submodule pin deliberately does
NOT sit on the tag their `version` names. See scripts/ci/check-module-pins.mjs.
An entry here is a claim that the drift is known and accepted, NOT a way to
silence the gate: `expect` pins the exact `git describe --tags` output, so a
record already exempt cannot drift FURTHER without failing. Widening the drift
is a deliberate edit to this file, which is a reviewable diff.
Delete an entry the moment the pins are reconciled. An exemption that has
stopped being true fails the gate too — `expect` must still match.

exemptions.reason: The source is three commits past published v0.3.2 for a Rust 1.96.1 toolchain pin; git diff v0.3.2..HEAD changes only rust-toolchain.toml. No bus or module code changed, so the registry retains the published v0.3.2 artifact and its release digest.

The provider is published independently at v0.2.3 while the shared source pin is tinyruntime v0.2.6. v0.2.3 was built against tinyruntime 09f9646 (v0.2.4-5); git diff 09f9646..v0.2.6 changes no crate source (only CI, toolchain, versions, Cargo.lock and the tinybus pin), and the tinybus module ABI is revision 1 on both. Registry retains its matching published v0.2.3 provider artifact.

Registry retains its matching published v0.2.3 provider artifact.

The source is seven commits past published v0.10.1 for Rust toolchain and CI/MSRV setup plus removal of obsolete Clippy allowances in tinybus_module/mod.rs.
